description: This Java class 'ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetter' extends 'AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter' to set acknowledgment requests for 'ThingCommand' objects, specifically for 'LIVE_RESPONSE' labels. It implements singleton pattern and provides methods to determine applicability and class matching.

classes.name: ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetter
classes.description: A singleton class that sets acknowledgment requests on 'ThingCommand' objects to respond with 'LIVE_RESPONSE' labels if applicable.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines if the given 'ThingCommand' is applicable for setting the acknowledgment request, by checking if it is a live channel command.

methods.name: getMatchedClass
methods.description: Returns the class object for 'ThingCommand' to match applicable command types.

methods.name: isBindResponseRequiredToAddingRemovingImplicitLabel
methods.description: Indicates whether binding responses are necessary for adding/removing implicit labels; returns true.
